.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml, gates/render/judge.toml, scored/polish/judge.toml, scored/visual/judge.toml and their prompt.md files
evidence: Every value the judges are told to create carries a distinctive JUDGE-* sentinel (functional: JUDGE-CS0/CS1, W0-W2, L1, M1-M3, WL0/WL1, R0-R3/R1B/RX, X0/X1, TE, H0-H3/H1C, E1, ME1/ME2, F1/F2, P1-P3, U1-U3, D1/D2, O, LB/LG/LA/LR/LE/LV, T0/T1, Q1-Q4, S0-S2; constraints gate JUDGE-G1; polish JUDGE-K1/K2). A case-insensitive grep for 'judge' over environment/, solution/ and instruction.md returns no hits, so neither the seed nor the reference markup/server contains any probe. The non-sentinel search probes that must find nothing or only the created message ('100%', 'A_1', '1000 pounds', 'Persist gone', 'Probate' after shortening, 'Insurer letter' after release, 'original lease scan', 'rent review date') were checked against seed_data.json: the literal-match probes are absent, and the expected-absent seeded texts occur only in the single seeded message that the criterion deletes/expires (K-13, K-17, K-1, K-10). The reference initial state is just the seed: server.js seedDatabase (lines 93-106) inserts only seed.matters messages and solve.sh only copies the app. Cross-probe substring collisions were also checked (JUDGE-M1 vs JUDGE-ME1, JUDGE-H1 vs 'Hold grandchild JUDGE-H1C', JUDGE-X0/X1, JUDGE-D1 vs -2 retry suffix); none makes a searched/mention probe pre-satisfied. Broken-app probe: an app that returns hard-coded JUDGE text cannot exist without the sentinel being in its source, and the golden contains none; a conforming alternative is not penalized because no probe depends on golden-specific content. This is a manual source review, not an execution of the private check-probe-not-in-seed.py; no runtime evidence is required for this row.
